analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 36.7로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램 -0.2350으로 개선세. 5일 저가 $53.37 대비 현재가 $54.10은 회복 신호. 그러나 주봉 ADX 16.8로 무추세 구간, 4시간봉 RSI 38.2로 여전히 약세. 변동성 ATR 8.15% 대비 손절폭 1.3배 설정 시 1.3 * $4.41 = $5.73. 현재가 $54.10 - $5.73 = $48.37. 이는 52주 저가 $37.32와 스윙 지지선 $51.61 사이에 위치. 손익비 1.5 이상 확보 어려움.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI at 36.7 has entered oversold territory, and MACD histogram improved to -0.2350. The current price of $54.10, compared to the 5-day low of $53.37, signals a recovery. However, the weekly ADX at 16.8 indicates a non-trending phase, and the 4-hour RSI at 38.2 remains weak. With an ATR of 8.15%, a stop loss of 1.3x ATR ($5.73) would place the stop at $48.37 ($54.10 - $5.73), falling between the 52-week low of $37.32 and the swing support at $51.61. This makes achieving a 1.5 risk-reward ratio difficult.
